Package model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
model.Player
Direct Known Subclasses:
Dealer, User
public abstract class Player extends Observable
Abstract class representing a player in the game.

Each player has a Hand, a Profile, and a GameStrategy. The class provides methods to manipulate the hand, get the strategy, and play according to the assigned strategy.
